plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any bid from others, bidding your value either wins you profit (if your value is higher than the second-highest bid) or avoids a loss (if your value is lower). Since this is round 1 of 1, there is no history to learn from. Therefore, I will bid my value of $39.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This ensures you win if and only if the prize is worth more to you than to any other bidder. Bidding less risks losing the item even when it's worth more than the winning bid, and bidding more risks winning an item that isn't worth the price. Given my value is $27, I will bid exactly that.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you want to win if and only if your value exceeds the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the item to someone who values it more, while bidding more than your value risks overpaying. Given my value is $13, I will bid $13.
